entities.summary: Subliminal (b. 1979-11-13, Tel Aviv) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Tel Aviv and Israel. Known in the fields of israel, composers & musicians, asia.
